about: The PC classic UNDERTALE comes to PlayStation®4! Explore a rich RPG world full of strange and delightful characters where violence isn’t the only answer.
Dance with a slime...pet a dog...whisper your favorite secret to a knight...or ignore all of that and rain destruction upon your foes. The choices are yours—but are you determined enough to prevail?
Features: · Killing is unnecessary: negotiate out of danger using the unique battle system.
· Time your attacks for extra damage, then dodge enemy attacks in a style reminiscent of top-down shooters.
· Original art and soundtrack brimming with personality.
· Soulful, character-rich story with an emphasis on humor.
